method.bars: 5m Yahoo chart, ~1 month: data.batch_fetch(mode='hybrid') with the crypto venues held in cooldown (OKX/Binance/Bybit/Coinbase return <= 350 5m bars)
method.hold: focus session only (no overnight): exit at the session's last bar
method.same_bar: stop before target; no same-bar entry fill
method.note: v1.5.0 gives crypto the whole ET calendar day as its session and no gap fade (a 24/7 market has no opening gap: on Yahoo's 5m alt bars a >= 0.15% step between consecutive bars is routine), so every crypto trade is a multi-day reverse (orange reclaim). The design was settled after the v1.4.1 crypto replay (research/replay_crypto_2026-10-04_v1.4.1.json) showed its fades firing on the midnight blue reset, and before this replay was run. Same bars and the same 36 names as that file (paired_v1_4_1_same_bars); ARB-USD, TON-USD and JUP-USD are excluded because Yahoo lists other tokens under them. Corrected 2026-10-04: the first version of this file included them, with 4 classic trades on TON-USD and JUP-USD (149 trades, +0.006R +/- 0.119). The paired gain is the gap fades going away, not the longer session: v1.4.1 with only its crypto gap fade switched off scores the same (sensitivity.v1_4_1_without_gap_fade). The null is not stable either: with the day starting at UTC midnight the same rules lose (sensitivity.utc_day).

causal_check.rule: first bar whose decision-time row is tradeable with its trigger on that bar (causal_check.py)

utc_day.what: v1.5.0, crypto's day relabelled to start at 00:00 UTC (20:00 EDT); same bars
utc_day.session_clock: UTC day (bars relabelled by their ET offset)
utc_day.bars: 5m Yahoo chart, ~1 month: data.batch_fetch(mode='hybrid') with the crypto venues held in cooldown (OKX/Binance/Bybit/Coinbase return <= 350 5m bars)

v1_4_1_without_gap_fade.what: v1.4.1 (equity clock, 00:00-16:00 ET) with its crypto gap fade switched off: multi-day reverse only; same bars
v1_4_1_without_gap_fade.command: git show 8e81493:engine.py | sed 's/else 0.15,/else 1e9,/' > old_nogap.py; python3 replay_crypto.py --bars <these bars> --engine old_nogap.py --exclude ARB-USD,TON-USD,JUP-USD
v1_4_1_without_gap_fade.bars: 5m Yahoo chart, ~1 month: data.batch_fetch(mode='hybrid') with the crypto venues held in cooldown (OKX/Binance/Bybit/Coinbase return <= 350 5m bars)

coinbase_bars.what: Coinbase 5m candles (volume on every bar) for the 43 names Coinbase lists (its ARB-USD and TON-USD are Arbitrum and Toncoin), Sep 4-Oct 3; both engines
coinbase_bars.bars: 5m Coinbase candles, 30 days, paged through the public candles endpoint
